textbookBox.concept: Changes happen to us and the world all the time. Some take years, some days or minutes. You grow taller, leaves fall and grow again, flowers bloom and dry up, and the sky changes colour.

1.tip: Look closely at the diagram on the board as we explain each property.

textbookBox.ref: CBSE Class 5 evs · Rhythms of Nature · Deeper Textbook Ideas
textbookBox.concept: Day changes into night and night into day. The Sun seems to rise in the east, move across the sky and set in the west. But is the Sun moving?

beats.en: Day changes into night and night into day. The Sun seems to rise in the east, move across the sky and set in the west. But is the Sun moving?
beats.speakEn: Day changes into night and night into day. The Sun seems to rise in the east, move across the sky and set in the west. But is the Sun moving?

beats.en: Game: one child is the Sun at the centre and another is the Earth, who turns slowly. While seeing the Sun, the Earth says day. When the Sun is out of view, it says night.
beats.speakEn: Game: one child is the Sun at the centre and another is the Earth, who turns slowly. While seeing the Sun, the Earth says day. When the Sun is out of view, it says night.

type: Day changes into night and night into day. The Sun seems to rise in the east, move across the sky

textbookBox.ref: CBSE Class 5 evs · Rhythms of Nature · Complete Summary
textbookBox.concept: With a torch and a globe: the torchlight is the Sun. The side where light falls has day and the other side has night. Rotate the globe slowly and watch the day and night sides change.
